primary.desc: cup rim end face (sealing face, incl. lug tops in the same plane)
primary.why: the rim end face seats against the group-head gasket; it is the functional axial datum of a portafilter

xy.why: the cast cup is turned about this axis; lugs and handle sit on it

xy.desc: cup rim bore above the basket flange
xy.why: coaxial bore of the same casting (tilt cross-check)

origin.definition: cup axis (outer wall) ∩ rim end-face plane

clock.why: the handle is the one non-axisymmetric feature that sets the part's orientation; its end cap is a clean flat perpendicular to the cup axis

landmarks.name: spout boss tips (part bottom)
landmarks.tol_source: intake exploration r-z plot (provisional frame, 0.5 mm reading resolution)

chk_scale.note: FLAG: no calipers (scan-only, DECISIONS MEASUREMENTS 2026-09-28); units assumed mm, scale unverified, none applied
